Replace betLimit = amount; with betLimit = amount + 1; so the stored value differs from the argument.
Delete the require statement in onlyOwner, allowing anyone to call AdjustBetAmounts and change betLimit.
Replace msg.sender == owner with true in the require, removing the access control on AdjustBetAmounts.
Replace the assignment to difficulty with a different value so the stored difficulty no longer matches the argument.

Replace the assignment with a constant zero so difficulty is always set to zero.
Replace `openToPublic = true;` with `openToPublic = false;` so the flag is set to the opposite value.
